card.name: Linking words after effect or Cmax terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (on, of, and) right after a drug effect noun or after C max in drug interaction text, just before the measured outcome such as AUC or a performance test.

modes.label: and after C max
modes.description: The word 'and' joining C max to AUC in pharmacokinetic interaction statements.
modes.example: prasugrel increased bupropion C max<< and>> AUC values by 14%

modes.label: on/of after effects
modes.description: 'on' or 'of' following 'effects' or 'impairment' before the thing affected.
modes.example: There are no data on the effects of clonazepam<< on>> milk production.

card.writes: Promotes words about probabilities and outcomes, suggesting a measured result or quantity comes next.
card.plain: It marks the little word that comes just before the measured result in drug interaction sentences, like AUC or an effect on a function.
